name: Beef
description: Red meat staple, curries to burgers.

histamine.note: Freshness rules: freshly cooked fine; aged steak and ground beef sitting around are worse.
histamine.why: SIGHI scores fresh beef 0 and marks it for perishability. Taseer has no perishability marker, so that risk sits in the score instead.

nutrition.highlight: iron and B12 in the form the body absorbs best
